content: Table package comparison for R multi-format: tinytable is the clear winner for R package Suggests dependencies — zero hard deps, supports HTML/LaTeX/Markdown/Word/PDF/PNG/Typst, author explicitly designed it for package developers. gt is most powerful for HTML but carries ~60 transitive deps, no direct LaTeX/Word in HTML-first mode (needs separate calls). kableExtra is HTML+LaTeX only, maintenance slowing, ~48 deps — not recommended for new code. flextable is best for Word/Office formats via officer, ~57 deps, no LaTeX. Practical split: tinytable for HTML+LaTeX in report templates (zero-dep, CRAN-clean); flextable or gt (with officer) only if Word-specific rich formatting is a hard requirement and author accepts dep weight. For es_report(): tinytable covers HTML/LaTeX/Markdown/Word all in one zero-dep package.
